## Factory review of 6cb2714: Approve

Every criterion holds: the fix works, its checks pass, the new tests fail without it, and nothing blocks.

| Criterion | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fit | Pass | does what it claims |
| Checks | Pass | ruff format/check, mypy, anthropic adapter pytest pass |
| Tests | Pass | 2 thinking-block tests fail without the fix |
| Blocking findings | 0 | none |
| Non-blocking findings | 0 | none |
| Risk | Low | backwards compatibility: empty `content` now raises ValueError, not IndexError |
| Review depth | Focused | private helper; public method signatures unchanged |

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Intent:** Make `AnthropicAdapter.generate_text()` / `async_generate_text()` return the first content block that has text, instead of only checking `response.content[0]`. Today, responses that start with `thinking`/`redacted_thinking` blocks (extended thinking passed through `**kwargs`) raise `ValueError: Anthropic returned unexpected content format`.
**Fit:** Both call sites now go through the new `_extract_response_text`, which scans `response.content` for the first block with a `.text` attribute. The diff changes nothing else. Since this branch was cut, main changed the same file in be808f6bef (#17366, `tool_choice: auto`). The branch still merges cleanly, those changes touch only the tool-calling path, and there is no other `content[0]` text extraction on main.
**Verified:** `ruff format --check` and `ruff check` are clean on both changed files.
**Verified:** `mypy --explicit-package-bases src` in packages/phoenix-evals: no issues in 64 files.
**Verified:** `pytest tests/phoenix/evals/llm/adapters/anthropic/`: 28 passed at the PR head, and 32 passed on the PR merged with current main.
**Verified:** With the adapter reverted to its parent and the new tests kept, the two thinking-block tests (sync and async) fail with the reported `ValueError: Anthropic returned unexpected content format`. The other three new tests pass either way; they guard behavior that already worked.
**Verified:** With the pinned anthropic 1.17.0, real `ThinkingBlock`, `RedactedThinkingBlock` and `ToolUseBlock` objects have no `.text`. `_extract_response_text([ThinkingBlock, RedactedThinkingBlock, TextBlock])` returns the text.
**Not verified:** `tox -e phoenix_evals` could not resolve its dependencies in the sandbox (litellm), so mypy and pytest ran from the uv workspace venv instead.
**Not verified:** CI's bare `mypy .` reports a module-path clash outside tox, so it ran with `--explicit-package-bases` instead.
**Not verified:** The full phoenix-evals suite was left to CI.
**Findings without a diff line:** none
**Risk:** side effects none, performance none, backwards compatibility low, from the area reviewers. One pre-existing limitation is left as is: when a response has several text blocks (citations, server tools), only the first is returned, as before.

Graded against the [review criteria](https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix/blob/main/factory/agents/pr-reviewer.md#verdict).

</details>
